object.selected_point: X_dagger(f), the maximum reached by the second branch of the canonical saddle on a stable selection chart

exact_chartwise_calculus.first_derivative: DG_r[f](h)=h(X_dagger); the h(S) term is zero in the six-pin conditional Cameron-Martin space

finite_obligation_set.statement: The second-branch maximum selection is covered, outside a residual event, by countably measurable C^1 charts with uniform overlap/multiplicity N_chart.
On every active chart, K_r^(6)(X_dagger,X_dagger)>=v0>0 uniformly in 0<r<=r0.
finite_obligation_set.available_input: KR-V-type covariance floors away from the collapsing pair

finite_obligation_set.statement: The selected maximum has a uniform inverse-Hessian moment sufficient for the Malliavin divergence estimate.
First residual-kernel derivative norms at X_dagger are uniformly bounded on the chart family.
For chart-local gain F_alpha, E|delta(DF_alpha/||DF_alpha||^2)|<=B_Mall uniformly.
finite_obligation_set.derived_route: variance floor + kernel derivative bound + inverse-Hessian moment + chart-cutoff derivative bound

finite_obligation_set.statement: For the canonical-pair determinant weight W_r, sup_u E_gamma[W_r 1_chart | G_r=u]/E_gamma[W_r] <=A_Palm uniformly near u=0.
The probability of chart switching, near-flat selected maxima, or uncovered selection configurations inside 0<G_r<ell is <=C_res ell.

conditional_theorem.statement: If the seven obligations hold with finite constants, then the pair-Palm gain law has density near zero bounded by M_Gamma=N_chart*A_Palm*B_Mall+C_res.

proof_skeleton: On a stable nondegenerate chart, differentiate the critical-point equation to obtain the critical-point motion formula.
Differentiate f(X_dagger(f))-f(S); stationarity of X_dagger and the six pinned value at S leave DG(h)=h(X_dagger).
The conditional Gaussian Cameron-Martin representative is the residual kernel section, whose squared norm is the residual variance.
Malliavin integration by parts bounds each chart-local Gaussian density by B_Mall.
The Palm fiber-weight bound transfers the Gaussian density to the determinant-weighted typed pair-Palm law.
Sum over at most N_chart overlapping charts and add the residual C_res*ell event.
not_claimed: The seven obligations are not discharged by this reduction.
The station exponent 91.6 is not a uniform density theorem.
The direct gain event is not removed from the Q0 condition set.
No decimal upper coefficient is promoted.
